quarterly_data.signal: Electrification segment table (in millions): Q2 2026 orders compare with $3,283 in the three months ended June 30, 2025 (93% year-on-year), and six-month orders were $13,460 versus $6,649 (102%); revenues were $3,637 versus $2,162, primarily from higher volume in switchgear and transformers at Power Transmission and in alternating current substation and high voltage direct current solutions at Grid Systems Integration; segment EBITDA was $671 versus $314, with segment EBITDA margin of 14.5% in the year-ago quarter. The raised 2026 Electrification revenue guidance is inclusive of approximately $3.1 billion from Prolec GE, up from $14.0-$14.5 billion inclusive of approximately $3.0 billion, with 18%-20% segment EBITDA margin.
